baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperfect verb يُسَبِّحُ governs the exhaustive parallel ما في السماوات وما في الأرض and terminates in four coordinated divine titles.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse assigns every inhabitant of the upper and lower domains an ongoing act that is simultaneously worship and the clearing of God from defect. The title chain names the addressee of that total liturgy as sovereign, pure, unconquerable, and precisely wise.

activation_trace.role: The worship-and-remembrance sense makes the imperfect verb an ongoing liturgical act rather than a bare description.
The clearing-and-exonerating sense makes that liturgy a continuous removal of defect from the divine referent.
What rises and overshadows supplies the entire upper domain of the verse's merism.
The lower realm opposite the sky closes the merism so that no created location remains outside the act.
Sovereignty gives the universal chorus a single governing addressee.
Purity and transcendence specify what the creatures' clearing speech continuously affirms.
Prevailing force prevents the universal praise from implying a negotiated or fragile kingship.
Accurate wisdom makes the final title the intelligence of the rule being praised.

changed_reading.before: A conventional opening report that creation praises God, followed by a list of names.
changed_reading.after: An ongoing and spatially exhaustive liturgy in which every inhabitant actively clears the sovereign, pure, prevailing, wise God of defect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُسَبِّحُ can carry running or swimming motion, while الملك العزيز الحكيم can be read through leadership, cohesion, solidity, and restraint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The whole cosmos is pictured as a moving procession rather than only a speaking choir. Upper movement and terrestrial resistance are held together by a leader, made coherent by firmness, and directed by a restraining bridle; patterned motion itself becomes praise.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming supply literal locomotion as the model's primary image for glorification.
The elevated canopy gives that locomotion an upper field of paths and cycles.
Clinging and heaviness toward the ground supply the resistant lower pole through which motion must be ordered.
The creature that goes in front and is followed turns kingship into directional leadership within the procession.
Hard ground and material cohesion keep the moving whole from dissolving into random flux.
The restraining piece of a bridle supplies controlled direction rather than mere velocity.

changed_reading.before: Glorification is imagined mainly as voiced praise by static occupants of two realms.
changed_reading.after: Creation praises through an ordered traffic of ascent, grounded resistance, following, and restraint under a leading sovereignty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tightly apposed sequence الملك القدوس العزيز الحكيم permits the titles to function as a mechanism, with يُسَبِّحُ supplying removal of defect.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title chain describes reparative governance: a rule with enough coherence to act removes contamination, strengthens what it governs, and restrains deviation for correction. Cosmic glorification is the creation's participation in, and disclosure of, that maintenance regime.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration supplies the model's removal of defect rather than praise as ornament.
Strength and internal coherence give rule the capacity to hold its field together.
Purification supplies the operation by which corruption is removed from the governed field.
Strengthening makes purification constructive: what is cleared is also enabled to stand.
Restraint that turns something back for repair supplies the corrective limit of the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The four titles are parallel honorifics appended to a praise statement.
changed_reading.after: The titles form a reparative sequence of coherent rule, purification, strengthening, and corrective restraint that creation manifests.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verses 62:2-4 enact the reparative title chain as human formation. A dormant group is stirred; signs arrive in a following sequence; purification both cleans and enables growth; teaching joins items into a transmissible whole; wisdom becomes learned precision. Others can catch up later, so the universal present of 62:1 is not a closed inventory but an expanding field funded by unearned surplus.

activation_trace.role: The focus title's purification sense supplies the state that the contextual formation process enacts.
The focus title's accurate wisdom supplies the governing intelligence that becomes teachable in context.
Stirring what is still breaks the group's initial inertia and starts the formation sequence.
Following and succession make recitation an ordered stream in which one sign leads after another.
Visible marks give the stream objects by which a formerly wandering audience can orient itself.
Purity and rectification directly activate القدوس as an operation performed within people.
A distinguishing trace that guides converts teaching into the inscription of usable orientation.
Joining one thing to another makes the book the coherent assembly of the taught marks.
Wisdom as knowledge that hits its object turns the focus epithet into a transmissible human capacity.
Deferral to a later time opens the formation process beyond its first recipients.
Later growth following the first crop images subsequent people as organic continuation rather than an unrelated audience.
Surplus and remainder explain how the expanding formation field exceeds the initial cohort without exhausting its source.

structural_cues: 62:2 moves from the completed sending to coordinated imperfect acts of reciting, purifying, and teaching.
62:2 changes the focus adjective الحكيم into the teachable noun الحكمة.
62:3 adds people who have not yet joined and repeats العزيز الحكيم before 62:4 names the whole movement as divine فضل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered verbal series, the purification/wisdom root echoes, delayed joiners, and surplus; I infer a causal formation pipeline that recruits people into the cosmic act. A live alternative is that the verbs are coordinate benefits and the later group only extends recipients without changing 62:1's cosmology.

changed_reading.before: The divine titles describe a completed cosmic order whose members already praise.
changed_reading.after: Purity and wisdom are also operations that awaken, mark, assemble, and teach new participants, so the cosmic present remains open to later attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated حمل in 62:5 separates carrying an entrusted disclosure from inwardly enacting it. A creature can physically bear books that disclose meaning while the responsible community denies the signs and remains unguided. This forces the universal praise of 62:1 to admit layers: material existence may testify to order even where conscious ethical response fails.

activation_trace.role: Worship is the strong baseline sense whose apparent universality is now qualified by failed human enactment.
Bodily motion supplies a non-deliberative layer on which a carrier can still participate in cosmic order.
External lifting unifies all three occurrences and exposes the insufficiency of mere physical possession.
Bearing an entrusted obligation supplies the ethical layer that the external carrier fails to realize.
A book that uncovers writing makes the carried load potentially revelatory rather than inert cargo.
Visible signs establish what should have crossed from exterior disclosure into recognition.
Assigning falsity blocks the transition from carrying a sign to answering it truthfully.
Gentle direction toward a path names the orientation that external carriage alone does not produce.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats حمل three times across entrusted people, their refusal to carry, and an animal carrying books.
The simile preserves physical carriage while denying equivalence between possession and guided response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contrast between external load, entrusted responsibility, visible signs, denial, and absent guidance; I infer a distinction between ontological or material glorification and conscious ethical glorification. A live alternative keeps all praise conscious and limits 62:5 to a critique of unused knowledge without revising 62:1.

changed_reading.before: The universal subject of glorification implies one uniform mode of conscious obedience.
changed_reading.after: Universal glorification can include a structural testimony borne by bodies and things, while responsible humans can still fail to carry disclosure inwardly or ethically.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verses 62:6-8 turn the locomotion latent in يُسَبِّحُ into an inescapable trajectory. Flight from death is still movement toward a meeting, then a return to the knower of hidden and witnessed domains, where action is disclosed. Sovereignty governs not only serene cycles but attempted exits; evasive motion can testify structurally to rule without becoming morally praiseworthy.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming supply the focus model of trajectories moving within a larger field.
Sovereignty defines the field from which the attempted flight cannot escape.
Judgment supplies the endpoint at which the trajectory is evaluated rather than merely stopped.
Loss of life and force supplies the boundary the addressees try to evade.
Literal escape supplies motion aimed against the sovereign field.
Two opposed paths coming together converts escape into an unavoidable encounter.
Return to a prior locus closes the attempted exit and bends the trajectory back to its ruler.
What is screened from eyes extends the sovereign knowledge beyond the visible path.
Presence under observation supplies the complementary exposed domain of that knowledge.
A delivered report turns the completed path into disclosed evidence.
Intentional deeds distinguish moral agency from the merely structural testimony of motion.

structural_cues: 62:6-7 first stage refusal through the challenge to desire death and the knowledge of what hands have advanced.
62:8 forms a directional chain: flee from, meeting you, returned to, then informed of deeds.
The paired hidden and witnessed domains echo the exhaustive upper and lower domains of 62:1 without repeating them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape, encounter, return, comprehensive knowledge, and disclosure of deeds; I infer that all trajectories remain enclosed by the focus kingship. The live alternative is a purely eschatological warning with no implication that involuntary motion itself bears witness or praise.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic swimming suggests only harmonious motion willingly aligned with God.
changed_reading.after: No motion exits the sovereign field: even flight is curved into meeting and evidentiary return, though its intention remains ethically resistant rather than praiseworthy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verses 62:9-10 split the two live senses of يُسَبِّحُ into a regulated pulse. A raised call gathers people for specified worship and remembrance, interrupting exchange; after the prayer, they unfold across the earth to seek provision while remembrance continues. Worship and livelihood are not rival zones but alternating phases held in one wise order.

activation_trace.role: Worship and remembrance supply the gathered phase of glorification.
Free movement for livelihood supplies the dispersed phase already latent in the same focus verb.
The raised call supplies the audible signal that reverses dispersion into assembly.
Specified worship gives the gathered phase a concrete practice rather than generic stillness.
A marked day or summons that gathers people supplies the pulse's centripetal movement.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end makes assembly active rather than passive.
Holding something present against forgetfulness names the center preserved across both phases.
Leaving something releases the assembly from exchange for a bounded interval.
Price-based exchange supplies the livelihood activity that is paused, not abolished.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the centrifugal movement after prayer.
Seeking a desired object gives dispersed movement a legitimate economic purpose.
Enduring success supplies the outcome of keeping worship, livelihood, and remembrance in rhythm.

structural_cues: 62:9 orders movement toward remembrance and the temporary release of sale.
62:10 begins when the same prayer is completed, then orders dispersion in the same earth named by 62:1.
Remembrance occurs before dispersion and is renewed during it, preventing a sacred-versus-economic split.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gather-pause-disperse-seek sequence and repeated remembrance; I infer a cyclical social metabolism that concretizes both worship and livelihood branches of يُسَبِّحُ. A live alternative reads the sequence only as legal scheduling and leaves the focus verb exclusively verbal or ritual.

changed_reading.before: Universal glorification is an uninterrupted sacred activity opposed to ordinary economic movement.
changed_reading.after: Glorification can be a governed alternation: gather and suspend exchange for remembrance, then spread through the earth for provision while retaining that center.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 62:11 supplies the failed counterpart to the authorized dispersion of 62:10. Visual attraction to trade or diversion breaks the gathered body apart and leaves its standing center; what is present with God and divine provision relocate value away from the lure. The focus titles now distinguish mobile order from fragmentation: livelihood movement can belong to praise, but decentered scattering cannot simply be equated with it.

activation_trace.role: Going about for livelihood supplies the legitimate motion whose corrupt imitation must now be distinguished.
Cohesion and structural strength make kingship the power that keeps moving parts a whole.
A bridle-like restraint supplies the limit that makes movement directed rather than distractible.
Immediate visual perception supplies the lure that captures orientation before reflection.
Profit-seeking trade supplies a legitimate good that becomes disordered when treated as the controlling center.
Being occupied away from one thing by another names the transfer of attention that precedes bodily scattering.
A gathered body breaking apart supplies the exact structural failure opposed to focus kingship's cohesion.
Abandoning the standing center completes the shift from lawful dispersion to rupture.
Nearness and presence relocate the durable good to what remains with God rather than what merely appears nearby.
Provision as apportioned gift denies that frantic departure is the ultimate source of livelihood.

structural_cues: 62:10 authorizes dispersion for فضل, whereas 62:11 marks a visually triggered انفضاض toward trade and diversion.
The crowd's motion leaves a person standing, giving the scene a lost center rather than mere geographical spread.
The closing comparison repeats trade and diversion, then ends on divine provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent dispersals with opposite evaluations, a standing center, and a provision closure; I infer that retained orientation, not immobility or rejection of commerce, separates praise-shaped motion from fragmentation. A live alternative restricts the criticism to one historical interruption and does not make cohesion a general condition of 62:1's motion image.

changed_reading.before: Any movement through livelihood can be folded directly into the cosmic glorification of 62:1.
changed_reading.after: Praise-shaped movement remains coherently oriented; the same economic mobility becomes anti-pattern when distraction fractures the assembly and abandons its center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of س م و to و س م and a form-distant rain-revival branch of ن ش ر. It remains anchored in السماوات, the adjacent earth, the later visible signs, and renewed spreading on earth. Render it only as a material analogy about the upper realm marking receptive ground, not as an ordinary derivation or a replacement for the direct sky sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السماوات is packet-mapped not only to elevation but also to visible marking, including first rain that marks earth with growth; الأرض immediately supplies receptive, fertile ground.

activation_trace.role: First rain leaving a vegetal mark turns the upper domain into an active inscriber of signs.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receptive surface on which the upper mark becomes growth.
Clearing away defect lets renewal function as a material analogue of purification and praise.
Visible signs activate the otherwise dormant image of a world made legible by marks.
Rain reviving dry pasture lets later spreading reactivate the focus pairing as regenerative expansion.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth are only two static compartments that totalize space.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the upper realm marks and renews receptive earth, so cosmic praise appears as a visible transfer that makes purity legible in growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates material instrument branches beneath divine titles: water that lets a company manage its affairs and a vessel used for purification. It remains anchored in the adjacency الملك القدوس and is awakened by يُزَكِّيهِمْ in 62:2. Downstream prose must present it as an infrastructural analogy for supplied purification, never as a literal identification of God with water or a vessel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent titles الملك القدوس carry packet branches for an enabling water supply and a purification vessel, allowing holiness to be modeled as provisioned capacity rather than only abstract status.

activation_trace.role: Water by which travelers can manage their affairs images kingship as supplying the medium that makes ordered life possible.
A vessel for cleansing materializes holiness as an available means of transformation.
Corrective restraint gives the cleansing medium a reparative purpose rather than a decorative one.
Contextual purification activates the focus title's dormant instrumental imagery.

changed_reading.before: الملك القدوس names an authority that possesses purity as an inaccessible attribute.
changed_reading.after: As a carefully contained analogy, sovereign holiness also supplies the medium and means by which a governed people can actually be cleansed and repaired.

strongest_changes: The divine title sequence became an enacted formation process of awakening, marking, purification, assembly, teaching, and later attachment.
The load-bearing simile split universal glorification into structural testimony and conscious ethical enactment.
The worship and livelihood branches of يُسَبِّحُ became a regulated gather-disperse pulse rather than rival sacred and economic spheres.
The contrast between authorized dispersion and distracted انفضاض made retained orientation and cohesion, not immobility, the criterion of praise-shaped movement.
Flight, meeting, return, and disclosure extended sovereignty over resistant trajectories without converting resistant intention into moral praise.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus verb sustained worship, exoneration, locomotion, and livelihood, while the context repeatedly tested how movement is formed, burdened, returned, gathered, released, or fractured. The most productive surprise was that 62:10 and 62:11 do not oppose motion to stillness; they oppose centered dispersion to decentered scattering.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether every creature's glorification is conscious speech, structural testimony, or multiple modes at once.
Reading attempted flight as involuntary witness to sovereignty is coherent but depends on a reader-supplied enclosure model.
The rain-marking and cleansing-infrastructure outliers depend on non-dominant or materially distant branches and should remain analogical.
The cohesion criterion may describe the specific interruption in 62:11 rather than every instance of economic movement.
